standard_prerequisites: Same chapter: lemma-field-maps-injective (a field map over the base is injective), lemma-algebraic-finitely-generated (an algebraic finitely generated extension is finite)
core_obligations: Finite case: f is an injective F-linear map of a finite-dimensional F-vector space, hence bijective

General case: f stays injective; for alpha in E take a vanishing polynomial P in F[x], let E' be the subfield generated by the roots of P in E (finite over F by lemma-algebraic-finitely-generated); f preserves the root set, so f restricts to an injective self-map of the finite-dimensional E', bijective by the finite case, putting alpha in the image
proof_roadmap: Settle the finite case by linear algebra
Descend to the finite subextension generated by the roots of one annihilating polynomial
